settings.gcn_architecture: two weighted symmetric-normalized graph-convolution layers with mean pooling
settings.gat_architecture: two weighted dense graph-attention layers with edge-weight attention bias and mean pooling

protocol.outer_test_policy: Each outer-test fold is evaluated exactly once after train-only epoch selection and full outer-train refit.
protocol.epoch_selection: One stratified split inside outer-train; validation ROC AUC with validation-loss tie-break selects epoch count.
protocol.preprocessing: Node-channel standardization is fitted inside selection-train or full outer-train only.
protocol.graph_preparation: Subject-local positive top-20-percent FC adjacency; fixed self-loops; weighted symmetric normalization for GCN and raw positive weights as GAT attention bias.

interpretation_limits: Internal repeated cross-validation only; no external or prospective validation.
Control status is the HC cohort while patient status is Study1/Study2; disease and study/cohort effects cannot be separated.
Architectures and training settings were frozen as small-sample comparators, not tuned clinical models.
GAT attention weights are model internals, not causal mechanisms or validated biomarkers.
research_notice: Research use only - clinician review required
